There is a φ s.t. no
graph G satisfies (Compφ).

Let φ be the “Russell
formula”: z ∉ z.
Then if G ⊨ Compφ, there is
a vertex r ∈ V s.t. r satisfies
(Compφ):
∀z (z ∈ r ↔ z ∉ z)
Plug in r for z:

Contradiction!
q.e.d.
